snippet.title: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y – DLC 1: Contract from the Darkness | Latest Update
snippet.description:
"When paths that should never cross finally collide…"
 
SUPER ROBOT WARS Y - DLC 1 “Contract from the Darkness” launches Early Access Nov 18th PST and General Access Nov 20th PST! GALAXY CYCLONE BRAIGER, THE BIG O, FUUTO PI: The Portrait of Kamen Rider & more await—don’t miss out!
 
Plus, Free Update Patch (v1.1.0) drops Nov 17th PST!

SUPER ROBOT WARS Y | Official Site: https://spr.ly/60577VrEN
 
#SuperRobotWarsY
